# Lensmor API Documentation

> Lensmor Event Intelligence API documentation for event discovery, attendee source intelligence, registered visitor access, exhibitor research, contact enrichment, credits, and profile matching.

## Primary Resources

- [Full documentation export](https://api.lensmor.com/llms-full.txt)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.lensmor.com/openapi.json)
- [API catalog](https://api.lensmor.com/api-catalog.json)

## API Base URL

`https://platform.lensmor.com`

Send requests to `https://platform.lensmor.com` with `Authorization: Bearer sk_your_api_key`.
